title: Too bad manufacturers try to make things cheaper
text: Too bad manufacturers try to make things cheaper. We bought this to replace our original one bought roughly 10 years ago.  What a difference! This one weighed considerably less and did not heat up as well. After four months approx one third of cooking surface failed to heat! Now we need to return it and we are out of a product we use to use at least twice a week!  Too bad manufacturers try to make things cheaper!
